name: teach-me
description: One adaptive education plugin for direct learning, teacher preparation, and age-appropriate teaching in English and simplified Modern Standard Arabic.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, prepare a lesson, or teach a child.
interface.longDescription: One Teach Me plugin for direct adaptive learning, compact teacher briefs, and safe age-appropriate explanations with meaningful visuals when useful. It supports English and simplified Modern Standard Arabic and can work from authorized sources.
defaultPrompt: Teach me a new topic from zero.
/teacher Prepare a one-page lesson brief for this topic.
/kids Explain this topic simply to a child with one useful visual.
